name: The Ogres of Feralas
summary: Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache wants the Gordunni ogres pushed back before they spread further into Feralas. Following the river north leads to their outpost, where ogres, ogre-magi and brutes are to be thinned out.

sections.title: The Mark of the Gordunni
sections.body: Rok Orhan points out that the Gordunni ogre tribe is hard to miss around here, since their very presence scars the land. They must be driven back before they reach deeper into Feralas. Their outpost lies up the river to the north. There you cut down ten Gordunni Ogres, ten Gordunni Ogre-Magi and five Gordunni Brutes, to show the tribe they are unwelcome.

faq.q: Who wants the Gordunni ogres driven back?
Why does Rok Orhan want the Gordunni pushed back?
faq.answer: Rok Orhan says their very presence scars the land, and they must be stopped before they expand further into Feralas.
Follow the river north, says Rok Orhan, and the outpost will be found there.
Ten Gordunni Ogres, ten Gordunni Ogre-Magi and five Gordunni Brutes.
The chain goes on with The Ogres of Feralas (2).
